mathematics.assertion_tested: All 2034 parameter records and their 52579 stored integer terms, polynomial coefficients, source-index maps and stated coefficient representations agree with independent exact constructions. This includes 55 complete coefficient tables (5083 cells) and 84 supported Appell columns (2016 terms). Full matching reproduces the retained OEIS report.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z and Q, exact Python integers and Fraction arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: Scalar windows contain 24 terms. Original parameter windows n=0..23; secancy columns k=1..8 begin at n=k; theta columns k=1..12 begin at n=ceil(k/2); theta specializations x=1..12 begin at n=0. Source degrees: reciprocal/CE/secancy Nn; tangent N(n+1)-1; Appell n; classical section Nn+j; theta 2n. Polynomial coefficients are ordinary coefficients, without k! scaling. Rational components are reduced with positive denominators. OEIS positions are export positions, not mathematical offsets. Additional tables retain all complete rows n=0..12. Ordinary triangle j=n(n+1)/2+k; theta j=n^2+k. Supported Appell column local n selects polynomial row Nn+k. Block-Appell tables use the positive j=0 block denominator; signs are retained. No zero coefficients are removed from tables.
inputs: Official OEIS terms and names snapshot dated 2026-11-15
non_claims: No novelty, distinctness, or general proof is inferred from the finite computation
OEIS matches do not prove infinite sequence identities
